title: Waldorf Salad
description: Waldorf Salad is a timeless continental classic featuring crisp apples, celery, grapes, toasted walnuts, and a creamy mayonnaise dressing. Served over fresh lettuce and finished with parsley, this elegant salad offers the perfect balance of sweetness, crunch, and richness.

ingredients.title: Ingredients
items: Seedless grapes – 80 g (halved, red or green)
Crisp lettuce leaves – for bed of salad
Fresh parsley – finely chopped, for garnish

instruction.title: 1. Prepare the Ingredients
steps: Wash and core the apples. Dice them into bite-sized cubes.
Toast the walnuts briefly in a dry skillet (2–3 minutes), then cool and chop.

instruction.title: 2. Mix the Salad
steps: In a large bowl, combine diced apples, sliced celery, halved grapes, and chopped walnuts.
Add mayonnaise and gently mix until everything is well coated.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.

instruction.title: 3. Chill (Optional but Recommended)
steps: Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 15–30 minutes to let the flavors meld.

instruction.title: 4. Serve
steps: Line a serving plate or bowl with crisp lettuce leaves.
Spoon the salad mixture on top.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve chilled on a bed of crisp lettuce.
Pair with grilled chicken, roasted turkey, or freshly baked artisan bread for a light continental meal.

chefTips: Use crisp apples such as Gala, Fuji, or Granny Smith for the best texture.
Toast the walnuts lightly to enhance their flavor and crunch.
For a lighter version, replace half of the mayonnaise with Greek yogurt.
Add a teaspoon of lemon juice to prevent the apples from browning.
